properties.accuracy_caveat: HIGH CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon tagged with the Mission Bay Parks system's own missionbayparks.com URL for this facility. Covers only this one mapped lot (roughly the Mission Bay Blvd. lawn/plaza between the Radiance and Nektar/Bayer buildings); the wider Mission Bay Commons interim-use area further west (Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens, the soccer field) is a separate, still-interim installation tracked as its own record below (Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim area) pending the Future Parks Project. These are expected dates, not events, and the sources differ: SF Rec & Park's project page gives an estimated schedule of design mid-2026, construction beginning late 2028 and opening to the public early 2030, yet the same page says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'; OCII's Nov 14, 2024 CAC update lists 'Transfer to SF Rec Park and Park (end of 2028, upon completion)'. No source reconciles the 2028 and early-2030 completion dates.
properties.p_number: OCII's own materials title the combined feature 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)' -- six separate open-space parcels. OCII's Nov 14, 2024 CAC update (timeline slide, PDF p.9) dates the opening of three of them: '1st Mission Bay parks open at Mission Creek P1, and at Mission Bay Commons P17 (2002)', 'P16 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2010)' and 'P11 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2015)'; the same slide says 'MB Commons interim use pilots begin on P13 (2016), P15 (2017), P12 (2018)', and SF Rec & Park's Workshop 3 deck (Apr 29, 2025, p.15) repeats the timeline. P12/P13/P15 are the interim-use strip, tracked separately below as 'Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons interim west'. This record's real OSM way (48569996) covers one specific mapped lot (the Mission Bay Blvd lawn/plaza) within that six-parcel assemblage; which exact P-number(s) it corresponds to is NOT confirmed by any source found -- left unconfirmed rather than guessed. (https://sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf)
properties.notes: Part of Mission Bay's parks system; open by fall 2010 per Wikipedia's Mission Bay article. OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update cites the 1998 'Design for Development' goals for the Mission Bay Commons as a whole, but no cited source states that this lot was completed as part of the original 1998 plan.
